name: Heritage Medallion
summary: Three joined domes and twin minarets sit inside a balanced circular medallion with integrated scrollwork.
why: The three roofs overlap deliberately into one prayer hall. All towers meet the same foundation, and the central doorway stays below the roofline. Gold accents belong to the building, while paired scrolls connect to the circular frame.
risk: This is the richer identity; the connected silhouette stays legible as fine ornament simplifies.
sub2: A dignified frame with a little richness
reasonToChoose: You want a dignified mosque emblem with traditional ornament.
